convert_checkpoint: convert a sharded FSDP checkpoint to a consolidated or sliced checkpoint format
run_convert_sharded_checkpoint_cli: run the CLI to convert an FSDP sharded checkpoint to consolidated format for evaluation
create_consolidated_checkpoint: create a consolidated checkpoint containing all model weights from a sharded FSDP checkpoint
create_sliced_checkpoint: create a sliced checkpoint with weights separated into separate files to limit memory usage
